overview_description.description:
Transit is a mobile app intended to help its users navigate their cities. Transit simplifies local travel in 125 cities worldwide. Upon launch, the bright, intuitive interface shows all nearby transportation options and departures. Users can plan trips, set reminders, and get notifications about disruptions. Plus, Transit also integrates other sustainable transport modes -- bike sharing, car sharing and Uber -- so users can determine the best way to get from A to B. With millions of active users in the US and Canada, Transit has emerged as the leading urban transit app in North America.

The company is based in Montreal, Quebec.

product.name: Transit App
product.description: A mobile navigation app for public transportation, walking, and biking that provides trip planning, nearby transit options, real-time vehicle data, transfer guidance, and step-by-step directions.

product.name: Transit Agency Solutions
product.description: Tools and services for transit agencies to provide branded rider information, integrate fares and mobility services, distribute service updates, and analyze rider feedback.

product.name: Transit API
product.description: An API that provides transit routing, real-time departures, service changes, on-demand transit information, detours, and crowdsourced mobility data for rider and agency software.

product.name: Transit Royale
product.description: A paid subscription offering that adds premium features to the free Transit app for users who want enhanced public transportation navigation and information.
